none: PAS LON-F80D08: A contemporary copy of a roman copper alloy As, possibly of Marcus Aurelius (AD 161-180).
contea di ritrovamento: Greater London (Inghilterra e Galles)

A contemporary copy of a Roman copper alloy as of Claudius I (AD 41-54) (Reece Period 1). Obverse: blundered legend and head left. Reverse S C, Minerva advancing right. Type as RIC I, nos. 100 / 116. See Boon, Counterfeit Coins in Roman Britain, pl. IV, no. 53 for a similar copy. Dimensions: diameter: 23.67 mm; weight: 4.86g
